title: Take small steps
summary: Move the arm in small steps and check the distance after each one.
guidance: Move the arm toward the object in several small steps instead of one long move, check the gripper-to-object distance after each step, and if a grasp misses, back off slightly and try again from a little higher.

title: Slow near the sink
summary: Move more slowly as the gripper nears the sink so it does not overshoot.
guidance: Approach the sink with smaller, slower steps and check the position after each one.

title: Re-grip when it slips
summary: If the object slips, let go and grip it again a little lower.
guidance: When the grasp slips, release and grip again lower on the object.

title: Lift before turning
summary: Lift the object a little before turning so it clears the counter.
guidance: Raise the object slightly before any turning move to clear the counter edge.

title: Open the gripper early
summary: Open the gripper before the final approach so it is ready to close.
guidance: Open the gripper before the last move toward the object.
